item.title: BREAKING NEWS: Major, multi-vehicle accident north of Minden
item.description: 10:30 a.m. BREAKING NEWS: Major, multi-vehicle accident at Dorcheat Road south of La. Hwy. 160. Those roads as well as Firetower Road are closed. Webster Parish Sheriff’s deputies are assisting Louisiana State Police and air rescue has been called. ROAD IS CLOSED at this time.

item.title: Word of the Day: Parlance
item.description: Word of the Day: Parlance Phonetic: /par·lance/Part of Speech: NounDefinition: a particular way of speaking or using words, especially a way common to those with a particular job or interest. “dated terms that were once in common parlance” Similar: jargon, language, phraseology.
